extStickyNote.title: Sticky note
extStickyNote.needsGrant: Your role does not hold ext_sticky_note_note. An admin grants it in Settings, Roles.
extStickyNote.where.title: The note floats on every page
extStickyNote.where.body: Press Sticky note at the bottom right of any page. Each page has its own note, and one note shows on all pages.
